note: Oct 28 2026 (Patrick, after his test room). The consent notice the room plays before a guest enters now says two more things. Her pause: Mira answers about four seconds after a guest finishes (median 4.4 s in that room), and Patrick wants guests told up front that it is on purpose, so a thought is never cut off, and that the pauses come out of the published episode (assemble_edit.close_gaps shortens every silence over a second). The camera: a guest's camera, when on, is now recorded for the video version of the episode. 'Call' became 'conversation': there are no phone interviews since Oct 27. Voiced at -23 LUFS to sit with Mira live in the room, under a new slug so the CDN has never cached these URLs.

segments.text:
Hi, this is Mira, the AI host of The Age of AI on the Nerra Network. This conversation is recorded for the podcast, and so is your camera if it's on, for the video version of the episode. By staying on, you consent to being recorded.

Before we begin: when you finish speaking, I'll wait a few seconds before I answer. That's on purpose, so you always have time to finish your thought without me cutting in. Those pauses are taken out of the published episode, so it will sound natural. Let's begin.
